name: Landed Matic – Freight Calculator and CBM Estimator
author: Renzo Johnson

sections.description:
Landed Matic is a freight calculator for importers, exporters and freight forwarders. Add [landed_matic] to a page and visitors enter up to three carton sizes with counts and weights, in centimetres and kilograms or inches and pounds.

It shows the total volume in cubic meters (CBM), the gross weight, the volumetric (dimensional) and chargeable weight by air freight (1:6000) and by express courier (1:5000), the density, which container the cargo fits (20ft, 40ft or 40ft high cube) and how full it would be, and the shipping mode that suits the shipment: international express, air freight, or sea freight by ocean LCL or FCL, with a typical door-to-door transit window from China to the USA.

Nothing is submitted. The calculations run in the visitor’s browser and no data is stored. A call to action links to your own quote form, set with the shortcode attribute, for example [landed_matic landed_matic_quote_url=”/get-a-quote”], and carries the shipment summary in the link so your form or your team can read it. A “Copy summary” button puts the same numbers on the clipboard.

For planning only, not a rate or a booking. Use it before asking your freight forwarder for a freight cost quote: carriers measure and round differently, and your forwarder confirms the price, duties and final mode.

Landed Matic is not affiliated with any freight or logistics company.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Put [landed_matic] in a page or post. Add landed_matic_quote_url=”…” to point the button at your quote form.
sections.faq:
How does it calculate CBM?

For each carton line it multiplies length, width and height in metres by the number of cartons, then adds the lines together. Inches are converted first.

What is chargeable weight?

The greater of the gross weight and the volumetric weight. Volumetric weight is the volume in cubic centimetres divided by 6000 for air freight and by 5000 for express courier.

Will my cargo fit in a 20ft or 40ft container?

The calculator compares the total volume and weight with the usable volume of 28 m³ for a 20ft, 58 m³ for a 40ft and 68 m³ for a 40ft high cube, with typical payload limits, and shows how full the container would be. Real loading depends on carton shape and stacking.

Does it show freight rates or landed cost?

No. It estimates volume, weight, container fit, mode and transit time. It does not price freight or calculate duties and taxes. The quote button hands the numbers to your form.

Does it contact a carrier or an API?

No. There are no remote requests, no accounts and no keys. The numbers are computed in the browser from standard volumetric divisors and container capacities.

Can I change the quote form the button links to?

Yes, with the landed_matic_quote_url shortcode attribute or the landed_matic_quote_url filter.
